name: Pounded rice cake
summary: A Hmong pounded rice cake. During culture week it is pounded in the street.
origin: Hmong cooking on the plateau. Bao Son La, 17 February 2023, and the Vietnam National Authority of Tourism’s winter handbook. VietnamPlus describes a pounding during the 27 August–5 September 2026 culture week. Bao Van Hoa puts a pounding in the January 2026 spring set.
howToEat: Eat it as the Hmong cake those articles name.
The culture-week pounding is a festival action, not a daily stall. The next date moves.
where: The plateau, as a Hmong dish. Festival grounds when a pounding is programmed.
